section: ### When the visa, the agency and the clearance are all real
old_str: The public prosecutor, Omar Faruq Faruqi, told the court the accused had taken Tk 24 thousand crore
new_str: The public prosecutor, Omar Faruq Faruqi, told the court that Masud Uddin Chowdhury had taken Tk 24 thousand crore
problem: OA0157: the prosecutor said 'this accused' (এই আসামি), i.e. Masud Uddin Chowdhury; 'the accused' reads as all 103 accused in the case.

section: ### When the visa, the agency and the clearance are all real
old_str: that police detained more than a hundred people together while he was at work,
new_str: that while he was working there police detained more than a hundred people together,
problem: RU0013 says 'সে দেশে কর্মরত অবস্থায়' (while employed in that country), not that he was at his workplace when detained.

section: ### Recruited while abroad or just back
old_str: In a case over a promised job in Australia reported in June 2026, the victim was a Bangladeshi working in Oman, approached in December 2025 through a person he already knew [FV0124].
new_str: In a case over a promised job in Australia reported in June 2026, the victim was a Bangladeshi working in Oman whom a person he already knew approached in December 2025 with an offer of work in Australia, according to CID (the police's Criminal Investigation Department) citing the case [FV0124].
problem: FV0124: the acquaintance himself contacted the victim (not 'through' him), and the account is CID's, citing the case; attribution was dropped.

old_str: BOESL, the government's recruiting agency, took the second-highest number of clearances, 771, and one of its workers became involved in the war (see When the visa, the agency and the clearance are all real) [RU0124, RU0125, RU0126].
new_str: BOESL, the government's recruiting agency, took the second-highest number of clearances, 771, and a responsible BOESL official told Prothom Alo that one of its workers became involved in the war (see When the visa, the agency and the clearance are all real) [RU0124, RU0125, RU0126].
problem: RU0125: that a BOESL worker became involved in the war is a BOESL official's statement; attribution dropped.

old_str: The SRB, the detective branch and others told Prothom Alo
new_str: The Special Response Battalion (SRB), a police unit, the detective branch and others told Prothom Alo
problem: Acronym SRB used before it is explained in this section (the expansion comes only in the next bullet, 'Death').

old_str: AFP reported that Mohammad Yasin Sheikh, 22,

old_str: Its draft report, published on the OHCHR website on 26 October 2026,
new_str: Its draft report, published on the website of the UN human rights office (OHCHR) on 26 October 2026,
